title: Jupiter in your birth chart: wisdom, expansion and the 5th and 9th aspects | Ask Tota
description: Guru is the greatest natural benefic, aspects both trikonas from wherever it sits, and spends a year per sign. Here is what Jupiter actually runs, house by house.
og_title: Jupiter aspects both of ur lucky houses at once
og_description: Guru reaches the 5th and 9th from wherever it stands, which is both trikonas. That is why its aspect is the most prized single influence in a chart.
h1: jupiter reaches both of ur trikonas at once
dek: guru aspects the 5th and the 9th from wherever it sits, which happens to be both of the fortunate houses. that one fact is why a jupiter aspect is the most prized influence in a vedic chart, and why a year of guru transit gets watched so closely.

faq.q: what does jupiter represent in vedic astrology?
faq.a: wisdom, judgement, dharma, teachers, law, higher learning, children and expansion. guru is the graha that decides what is worth doing, as distinct from mercury which processes and the sun which decides.
dhanu and meena. its mooltrikona is dhanu from 0 to 10 degrees. it is exalted in karka, deepest at 5 degrees, and debilitated in makara, deepest at 5 degrees.

faq.q: why is jupiter's aspect so valued?
faq.a: because it aspects the 5th and 9th from itself, which are both trikonas, the fortunate houses. no other graha reaches both. a house receiving guru's aspect is traditionally treated as protected.

it is the greatest natural benefic. but for some lagnas it rules difficult houses, and a natural benefic ruling a kendra loses strength under kendradhipati dosha. so it can be a benefic by nature and unhelpful for u specifically.

faq.q: how long does jupiter stay in one sign?
faq.a: about a year, and a full circuit takes roughly twelve years. that is why a jupiter transit is watched so closely: it defines a year at a time.
jupiter in a kendra from the moon, meaning the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th sign counted from ur moon. that is four of twelve, so roughly one chart in three has it.
jupiter sitting with rahu. the traditional reading is that rahu's appetite attaches to jupiter's judgement, so belief becomes something to win with. a tendency, not a verdict.
16 years in vimshottari. it is usually described as a period of growth, learning, teaching and expansion, for better and for worse, because expansion is not always wanted.
punarvasu, vishakha and purva bhadrapada. if ur moon was in one of those at birth, ur dasha sequence started with jupiter.

faq.q: which house is jupiter strongest in?
faq.a: the 1st, by directional strength. digbala puts guru at full force on the ascendant, which is also traditionally treated as one of the most protective placements in a chart.

faq.q: what does jupiter say about children?
faq.a: guru is the putra karaka, the significator of children, read alongside the 5th house. as always, describe the placement rather than making predictions about a real family.

faq.q: why is jupiter debilitated in makara?
faq.a: makara is saturn's sign of structure, limits and pragmatism. a graha built for expansion, faith and generosity is least at home in the sign most concerned with what things cost.
